detail.longDescription: Project N.O.M.A.D. (Node for Offline Media, Archives, and Data) is an open source offline knowledge server. Its Command Center sets up Kiwix for offline Wikipedia, Ollama for local AI, Kolibri for education, ProtoMaps for maps, and CyberChef. Do note there's no authentication by default, so keep it on your LAN or behind something like NetBird. https:// techhut.tv/project-nomad-offli ne-knowledge-server # SelfHosted # Homelab # Offline
